VIDEO INTRODUCTION:
Hi everybody,
There is a tectonic shift happening in the IT industry of India.
In FY26, TCS laid off around 8,000 people in one of the largest layoff exercises in its history.
And in the same financial year, India’s top five IT services companies, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, HCLTech and Tech Mahindra, saw their combined workforce shrink again!
Their combined headcount fell by 7,389.
